docs(adr): 0002 decision records for huge-range fail-closed + OCR_INDEX
The docs-checker (config_surface family) flagged both surfaces as missing a

and the index default-ON env switch, satisfying the checker contract.

Relay chains write openrouter/anthropic/claude-... -- one split left the
mid-chain vendor in place and defeated the provider deny-list (merge-tip
finding, still present). Now all prefixes peel; two more pinned cases.

fix: user-chosen judgement items — blob-size caps, nearest anchoring, manifest scope
7524: _diff_exceeds_caps now measures both blob sizes (git cat-file -s)
instead of materializing the whole diff; deliberate conservative over-count,
documented. 6463: _reanchor_finding anchors the occurrence nearest the
stale line, not blindly the first. 7268: _build_review_manifest takes a
_ManifestScope grouping the always-travelling identity pairs
(common_dir+run_id, k+total); both call sites + test manifest builders
migrated. Suite: 23 t24 lows + 28 precomputed_diffs green.

README listed 'sed -n' on the reviewer-sandbox bash allowlist, but

writes files; GNU sed executes the shell) -- the extension is unchanged;
the docs now match it.

0.9.x argv; the note now says default path and names the exceptions.
